description: Krate's reference for writing a Krate app (a native app for Windows, macOS and Linux that also opens in a browser): the files an app is made of (Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, manifest.toml), the API it may use, the permissions it may declare, the mistakes that fail a first build, and worked examples. No sign-in needed.
name: get_krate_guide

characters.description: The guide's length; the guide itself is the text content

title: Read the Krate app guide
